topic_title: Definition of Traffic Flow & Operational Dynamics
prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §545.363, when is driving at an unusually slow speed illegal on highways?

options.text: Whenever driving precisely five miles per hour under the posted maximum limit
Exclusively when operating a commercial agricultural tractor during daylight
When driving so slowly as to impede the normal and reasonable movement of traffic
Whenever traveling with four-way emergency hazard blinkers actively engaged
